about_short_description.short_description: Algebra Intelligence is a software development firm that integrates artificial intelligence solutions into the energy sector.

product.name: Monitoring Solutions
product.description: Software solutions for monitoring power systems in facilities and power plants to reduce electricity consumption and improve performance.

product.name: Predictive Maintenance
product.description: AI-driven platform to remotely monitor operational equipment and predict maintenance needs to prevent failures and maintain optimal performance.

product.name: Asset Performance Management
product.description: A tool for managing power plant assets to reduce risks, control costs, and support informed business decisions for plant longevity and profitability.

product.name: Energy Forecast Solutions
product.description: AI-based energy forecasting tool that provides accurate data to optimize plant operations, financial performance, and planning.

product.name: Energy Efficiency Services
product.description: Energy audits and system analysis to reduce wasted energy and lower utility costs in residential, commercial, and industrial environments.

product.name: Testing and Commissioning
product.description: Testing and commissioning services for low and medium voltage electrical systems, including thermal imaging and compliance with national and international standards.
